description.value: Witset RV Park and Campground serves the community of Witset (formerly Moricetown), a Wet'suwet'en First Nation community situated along Highway 16 in the Bulkley Valley of northern BC. The campground is a practical stop for cycle tourists riding the Yellowhead corridor between Prince Rupert and Prince George. Its location near the Witset Canyon, a culturally significant salmon fishing site, adds interest for touring cyclists passing through.
